title: Rapallo at Coconut Point Estero FL: Who Pays for the Amenities in 2026?
excerpt: Rapallo's 540 owners fund a staffed clubhouse, five pools, and five lighted Har-Tru courts with no CDD and no golf revenue - roughly $8,064 to $10,172 a year in fees. The amenities turn twenty this year, which makes the reserve position, not the fee, the thing that decides your purchase.
